title: Global Energy Regime Awareness Schema
description: A minimal, non-intrusive schema for declaring operating regimes, validity assumptions, and boundary semantics within energy systems.

declared_regime.description: A human-readable identifier for the current energy operating regime.

operating_envelope.description: A description of the bounds within which regime assumptions are considered valid.

validity.description: The current validity state of assumptions within the declared regime.

boundary_semantics.description: Interpretive guidance for approaching or crossing regime boundaries.

non_catastrophic_exit.description: Expected interpretation or behavior when exiting the regime without system failure.
